neighbours.label: an unrealized possibility or plan contrasted with what actually happened ('was supposed to', 'could have'), as against the same events stated as having happened
fire: The bridge was supposed to open in May, but it is still closed.
Twice the goalkeeper could have stopped the shot, but he slipped.
The concert was originally supposed to take place outdoors.
Under different rules, she might have won the race easily.
My brother was supposed to call me last night, but he forgot.
The general could have ended the war in a week, but he waited.
According to the timetable, the train was supposed to leave at nine.
With a little luck, they could have reached the summit before the storm.
quiet: The bridge opened in May, and it is busy every day.
Twice the goalkeeper stopped the shot, and the crowd cheered.
The concert took place outdoors in the park.
Under the new rules, she won the race easily.
My brother called me last night after dinner.
The general ended the war in a week.
According to the timetable, the train left at nine.
With a little luck, they reached the summit before the storm.

predictions: fire 0.1-0.4 on ' supposed' and ' have' in counterfactual frames; factual versions below 0.05; 'supposed' strongest
notes: Card: ' have' x8 (could have killed Saul, might have enjoyed), ' supposed', ' wanted', 'circumstances', 'Once', 应当; + pole promotes ' but'.
